senses.gloss: m. pl., constr. מַעַרְכֵי (b. h.; arrangements, ordinances, esp. מ׳ (כהן) מלחמה the regulations concerning excuses from the army to be proclaimed before battle (Deut. XX, 5—9).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 7:18">Tosef. Sot. VII, 18</cite> on arriving at the frontier he says, <he>מי ששומע ילך לשמוע מ׳ כהן מלחמה</he> let him who hears (this) go to hear the proclamation of the priest of war (v. <cite ref="M02822"><he>מָשׁוּחַ</he></cite>); <he>במ׳ מלחמה מהו אומר</he> what is said in the proclamation before the battle? <cite ref="Sotah 42b:1">Sot. 42ᵇ</cite> top <he>שמעו דברי מ׳ מלחמה</he> listen to the words of the proclamation.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 8:2">Ib. VIII, 2</cite> <he>כל אלו שומעין דברי כהן מ׳ וכ׳</he> all these listen to the words of the priest appointed over the ordinances of battle and go back &c.; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 193:5">Sifré Deut. 193</cite>, sq.—V. <cite ref="P01377"><he>עֵרֶךְ</he></cite>.
